messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — travel hit a snag, flight delayed. I’m primary for 09:00-13:00 UTC today but I’ll probably miss the first 2 hrs. Can someone cover primary from 09:00-11:00 UTC? I’m already mid-handoff, copying triage notes below.

Alex Chen: Current status: P2 on inference-prod — elevated 5xxs ~3.4% for the last 7m, traffic still routing to model-v2. No active deploys in the last hour. I started initial checks: logs, pod restarts, and KV cache.. more below.

IncidentBot: Pager triggered (P2) — inference-prod: 5xx rate spike > 3% (detected 7 minutes ago). PagerDuty link: https://pd.redwood.com/incidents/INC-4312 :rotating_light:

Priya Singh: I can take primary for 09:00-11:30 UTC if that helps. @Alex Chen — please paste the runbook snippet and any quick commands you ran.

Alex Chen: thanks @Priya. quick commands I ran: 
```
# check recent restarts and error logs
kubectl get pods -n inference-prod -o wide | egrep 'model|gateway'
kubectl logs deploy/gateway -n inference-prod --since=10m | tail -n 200
# check cpu/mem and 5xx counts (internal metrics)
redwood-metrics query 'sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="gateway",status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (instance)'
```
I also toggled a temporary routing fallback to model-v1 for 10% traffic to see if errors drop (was manual override in routing console).

Samir Rao: Copy. Priya — if you take primary, can you confirm you can access the routing console and run the quick fallback rollback if needed? Credentials: lastpass entry "oncall/routing-console".

Priya Singh: I have access. Quick sanity check: if 5xxs correlate with model-v2, prefer rollback to model-v1 and ramp slowly. Runbook excerpt — Oncall > inference > model-5xx-spike: https://redwood.team/runbooks/inference-5xx-spike

Maya Patel: FYI ops-rotation calendar still shows Alex as primary until 13:00. Someone should update the calendar or Ops-Rotation bot so pager routing matches.

Ops-Rotation: Rotation update request received. To confirm: temporary primary swap Alex -> Priya for window 09:00-11:30 UTC. Reply `confirm` to apply.

Alex Chen: confirm (handoff notes below).

Priya Singh: confirm. Taking primary now. Alex — leave any sticky notes for me (incidents, customer impact).

Alex Chen: Notes: affected customers mostly internal staging jobs and a handful of EU latency-sensitive calls. Customer impact: elevated error rate, some retries causing client-side latency spikes. No incident page or customer-facing post yet. Escalation threshold not hit for P1.

Alex Chen: Troubleshooting logs/observations:
- gateway logs show repeated 502 from model-v2 instances around 12:03 UTC
- model-v2 pods had one restart each on index-3 and index-7 ~12:01 UTC, but steady now
- internal health probes show kv-cache misses slightly increased

Priya Singh: Taking over triage. First actions I’ll perform in order: 
1) Check metrics to confirm error rate source (gateway vs model).
2) Reduce model-v2 traffic to 0% if 5xxs persist, shift to model-v1 fallback.
3) Kick off a quick rolling restart of model-v2 if errors persist after fallback.
4) Post short update in #incidents and notify SRE if P1 risk.

Priya Singh: Running step 1 now — query: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="gateway",handler="generate",status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (target_model)`

Priya Singh: metrics show 5xxs are concentrated to target_model="model-v2" and higher on a subset of instances. Good candidate for rollback.

Samir Rao: If you need to mass-roll model-v2, ping infra oncall as well. Also consider KV cache warming for model-v1 to avoid latency cliffs when shifting traffic.

Priya Singh: Good call. I’ll ramp 100% to model-v1 over 3 steps: 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 2m observation windows. Rolling now to 20%.

Priya Singh: After 20% shift: 5xxs dropped to 1.2% overall. Proceeding to 60%.

Priya Singh: At 60% — errors at 0.8%. Proceeding to 100%.

Priya Singh: 100% on model-v1 — 5xxs now ~0.3% and trending down. Looks stable.

Alex Chen: Thanks @Priya — appreciate the quick handoff. I’ll update the calendar and add a short postmortem note to the incident ticket later today.

Ops-Rotation: Rotation swap applied to calendar and pager routing. New primary: Priya Singh (09:00-11:30 UTC). Backfill requested: Alex remains secondary starting 11:30 UTC.

Maya Patel: Leaving a reminder: please add a short blameless note in the incident ticket with the rollback steps and PID for model-v2 pods involved (index-3, index-7). Also tag @research to check model artifact checksums.

Priya Singh: Will do. Adding runbook pointer and minimal actions to PD incident: fallback applied, model-v2 pods restarted scheduled for 12:40 UTC (if needed), customer impact limited to short retries.

Alex Chen: final: thanks everyone. If Priya needs me between 11:15-11:30 for brief sync, I’ll be reachable on Slack. Safe handoff. :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: Copy. taking primary fully. Monitoring for 15m then will hand back to Alex per calendar.

Samir Rao: Nice tight swap — good notes.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-4312 transitioned to status: mitigated by routing fallback. Postmortem suggested if recurrence within 72h.

Priya Singh: closing thread for now — will update PD and add notes.
